name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_finalize_and_destroy
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::FinalizeAndDestroy frees the clip polygon point buffer, destroys the optional Weiler state, and frees the clip polygon object.
known_limits: The smoke verifies the public cleanup/no-crash path rather than inspecting memory after free. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ab10 validates optional free(points), DestroyState(weilerState), and final free(clipPolygon).
The native clip-polygon smoke destroys a populated clip polygon created from points and also destroys a zero-initialized clip polygon with no points or Weiler state.
